name: Kazakh küy (instrumental dombyra art)
lineage: Kazakh küy classical instrumental art-music tradition of Kazakhstan, performed on dombyra two-string long-necked fretted plucked lute as solo virtuoso narrative-programmatic compositions. Each küy narrates a historical-mythological story through purely instrumental means: the canonical "Aksak Kulan" tells of a son's death announced through dombyra after no one dared speak the news. Two regional schools: Western tökpe (more rhythmically vigorous) and Eastern shertpe (more lyrical-contemplative). Kurmangazy Sagyrbayuly (1818-1889) and Tattimbet Kazangapuly (1815-1862) are canonical composers.
